notes.title: Patch 1.0.3d out! 32bit support and translations!
notes.notes:
Aside from minor bug and typo fixed, newest version of HEADLINER adds a 32bit support for Windows and Linux! If you run into any issues, post in the forums and let me know, but it all should be working as far as the testing I've done :)

The bigger change introduces support for unofficial translations! So if you want to see HEADLINER in your language, now you can :D 

Grab the files and read the full tutorial here!

Hope to see HEADLINER in some new languages!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29997458/653f4632340098bba1d19f446830b212df8fe0fd.jpg

Once again thanks to fluffy for lending me their Macbook Mini and making the Mac version happen :) And thanks to all the previous tester for re-confirming the new version works!

notes.title: First Patch Out & Breaking 1K Sales!
notes.notes:
Just pushed the first post-launch update, in time to celebrate passing the first 1000 sales, woo! 

Please share and tweet around, keep the #FakeNews going!

Let's Make Gaming Great Again™ ;D

Kudos to Nelson, aves78, Lacie and Boxy_Snail for pointing out a few typos and suggestions!

Changes: 

 [FEATURE] Added setting to disable tutorial for multiple playthrus
 [BUG] Fixed a Day 6 convo bug that didn't set spouse's face correctly
 [WRITING] Fixed typos (No more pursit kids, should't)
 [WRITING] Minor text update to checkpoint
 [WRITING] Fixed he/she typo on Day 2 Convo (She seemed frazzled lately) and in ending text (treated her illness)


Lastly, Big Thanks to Chilled Chaos, WeaselZone and Mr. Falcon for Lets Playing the game, and all of YOU who helped spread the word! 

I really appreciate the support :)
